Remove files/dirs, or smartly clean project artifacts when no path given

Usage:
  ycy rm [paths...] [flags]

Flags:
  -d, --depth string   Smart scan depth (default: 5)
  -f, --force          Skip confirmation prompt
  -h, --help           help for rm

Global Flags:
      --log-format string   Diagnostic format: text or json
      --log-level string    Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
      --quiet               Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose             Enable debug diagnostics
